reel_input.concept_seed: An intimate close-up of a composed face. The camera arcs and reveals the face is a thin surface with no head behind it, only depth: a vast black-stone hall where the person walks away. The camera pulls back until the gap is enormous, then follows the person into a warm, complex interior the surface never showed. The surface stays exactly where it was. The film returns to the face.

visual_prompt.primary_prompt: Restrained photorealistic 9:16 film about one face that turns out to be a thin surface with a vast world behind it. Close-ups of a calm adult face, a black-stone hall with hairline antique-gold (#C6A94F) veins, and a warm, lived-in interior at its end. Slow, physically credible camera, real light. No lettering, no horror, no cracks, no lens flares, no floating objects.
visual_prompt.runway_prompt_modifier: Hard-geometry CAD aesthetic. No organic morphing. Rigid wireframe transitions only.

global_visual_matrix.rendering_engine: Runway gen4.5. Hard-geometry CAD aesthetic, no organic drift.
anti_drift_rules: NO liquid, fluid, or organic morphing. Geometry must remain rigid.
NO floating particles or ambient debris unless specified.
NO lens flares unless tied to crimson interference event.
ALL transitions must be cut-hard or precision wipe. No dissolves.
Maintain 9:16 vertical framing at all times. No reframe.

script.full_text: You can see someone every day... and mistake it for knowing them. You know their voice, their laugh, the way they cross a room. Familiarity hides distance well. What someone lets you see, and who they are when no one is watching, are not always the same. You can know every expression on a face and still never see what lives behind it. Presence is not access...
script.mobius_note: Final segment stays open: 'is not access...' resolves at loop restart with 'You can see someone every day...'.

segments.text: You can see someone every day... and mistake it for knowing them.
segments.visual_prompt: Intimate close-up at eye level of a woman in her mid-twenties of mixed heritage with warm light-brown skin, hazel-brown eyes, shoulder-length dark curly hair in loose natural curls and a composed, neutral expression, wearing a charcoal crew-neck sweater. Soft warm key light from the left, deep near-black background (#1A1A1A). Real skin texture, a natural catchlight, calm eyes looking just past the lens. The face fills most of the frame and reads at phone size. Nothing unusual is visible yet. No lettering, no glow, no masks, no makeup effects. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain. Motion: Very slow camera move to the right, already moving on the first frame. She blinks once and breathes; her expression stays composed and does not change. The background stays dark. Her face does not change shape. No new people.

segments.text: You know their voice, their laugh, the way they cross a room. Familiarity hides distance well.
segments.visual_prompt: The same woman's face seen from a three-quarter angle behind and to the side: the face is an extraordinarily thin, slightly translucent surface, like fine porcelain, holding the same composed expression. There is no head behind it. Past its edge opens a vast dark hall of black stone (#1A1A1A) with hairline antique-gold (#C6A94F) veins, and far down the hall a small figure in a charcoal sweater walks away from the surface. Strong depth. The surface is calm and beautiful, not eerie. No cracks, no horror, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain. Motion: Slow camera arc to the left around the surface. The face-surface holds completely still with the same expression. Far down the hall the small figure keeps walking away at an even pace. The architecture does not change shape. No new people.

segments.text: What someone lets you see, and who they are when no one is watching, are not always the same.
segments.visual_prompt: Wide view down an immense black-stone hall (#1A1A1A) with hairline antique-gold (#C6A94F) veins. In the near foreground, small at the lower left, the thin translucent face-surface stands upright on its own, facing away from the hall. Far in the distance, a small figure in a charcoal sweater walks toward a faint warm light. The gap between the surface and the figure is enormous. Cool dusk light, fine dust in the air. No lettering, no portals, no glow halos. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain. Motion: Slow, steady pull-back down the hall. The surface in the foreground stays still and grows smaller. The distant figure keeps walking toward the warm light. Dust drifts. The architecture does not change shape. No new people.

segments.text: You can know every expression on a face and still never see what lives behind it.
segments.visual_prompt: A vast warm interior at the end of a black-stone hall: tiers of rooms, a wall of books, a long wooden table with a coat, plants and open notebooks, a tall window with green garden light, a staircase rising into gold (#C6A94F) light, bone-white (#F5F2EB) highlights. Small in the middle ground, a woman in a charcoal sweater stands in the light, seen from behind, at ease. Beautiful, lived-in, warm and complex. No lettering, no faces, no lens flares. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain. Motion: Slow push-in toward the warm interior. The woman turns her head slightly toward the window light. Soft light shifts across the shelves. The architecture does not change shape. No new people.

The same intimate close-up as the opening: a woman in her mid-twenties of mixed heritage with warm light-brown skin, hazel-brown eyes, shoulder-length dark curly hair in loose natural curls and a composed, neutral expression, wearing a charcoal crew-neck sweater, composed, against near-black (#1A1A1A), warm key light from the left.
